results.change_intent: Expose the frdToVTK converter function to Python under the Fem module when VTK support is enabled.
results.summary: The Python binding correctly parses arguments, frees allocated memory, and delegates to FemVTKTools::frdToVTK without issues.

results.change_intent: Implement a CalculiX .frd file reader and exporter to convert FEA results into VTK MultiBlock datasets.
results.summary: The reader implementation contains critical bugs including non-null-terminated buffer reads in value parsing, unbounded loop increments that can bypass end iterators, unconditioned point insertions that will crash on non-coordinate lines, and invalid block indexing when no result grids exist.

issues.comment: sub.data() points into the underlying string without being null-terminated at digits length. std::strtol and std::strtof ignore the digits width and parse until encountering whitespace or an invalid character, which will misparse adjacent columns in fixed-format files. Additionally, std::strtof parses only single-precision floats, discarding double precision.
issues.suggestion: Copy the substring into a small null-terminated buffer or std::string (e.g. std::string(sub)) before calling std::strtol / std::strtod, or use std::from_chars for integers.

issues.comment: Using it != vi.end() with a stride of it += 12 (as well as in lines 282, 449, and 467) causes an infinite loop and buffer overrun if the remaining length is not an exact multiple of 12 (such as when lines have trailing whitespace or CRLF endings in binary mode). it skips right past vi.end() and never equals it.
issues.suggestion: Change the loop condition to ensure at least 12 characters remain, e.g. for (; it + 12 <= vi.end(); it += 12). Apply the same fix to the other fixed-stride loops over vi and sub.

issues.comment: points->SetPoint and mapNodes[node] = nodeID++ are executed outside the if (view.rfind(keyCodeCoord, 0) == 0) block. If a line does not start with keyCodeCoord, coords is empty, causing points->SetPoint to dereference coords.data() (nullptr), triggering a crash. nodeID is also erroneously incremented.
issues.suggestion: Move points->SetPoint and mapNodes[node] = nodeID++ inside the if block, and ensure coords has at least 3 elements before calling SetPoint.

issues.comment: If grids is empty, multiBlock->SetNumberOfBlocks(0) is executed. Then multiBlock->SetBlock(0, grid) is called on index 0 of a dataset with 0 blocks, causing an out-of-bounds error or assertion failure in VTK.
issues.suggestion: Call multiBlock->SetNumberOfBlocks(1) inside the if (grids.empty()) branch before setting block 0.

results.change_intent: Declare a static method `frdToVTK` in `FemVTKTools` to convert CalculiX .frd result files into VTK datasets.
results.summary: The method declaration is concise, consistent with the class interface, and matches its implementation.
